scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:library-policy: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsc src/lib/library-policy.ts src/lib/library-policy.test.ts --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --outDir ../../tmp/library-policy-test --skipLibCheck --strict --esModuleInterop --types node && node tmp/library-policy-test/library-policy.test.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
